target: EDA mean over t+25s to t+30s
timing_contract: After120s observed history, every5s predict a future5s EDA mean ending30s later. All EDA,temperature and accelerometer summaries are causal and aligned by native starts/sample rates.
calibration: No held-person outcome calibration. Past120s EDA is permitted state, identical for every model; response coefficients and flexible transforms fit training people only.
independent_unit: Participant; all aerobic segments of a person linked

reference.equation: e; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

baseline_persistence.equation: e; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

baseline_velocity.equation: e+v; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

baseline_flexible.equation: e+b0+sum_j b_j exp(-mean((z-center_j)^2)/2); e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

attempt_001_relaxation.equation: e+b0*r; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

attempt_002_damped_drift.equation: e+b0*v+b1*r; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

attempt_003_activity.equation: e+b0*v+b1*r+b2*A; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

attempt_004_thermal.equation: e+b0*v+b1*r+b2*dT; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

attempt_005_asymmetry.equation: e+b0*max(v,0)+b1*min(v,0)+b2*r; e=current5s EDA mean(uS), v=3*(e-e_t-10s),r=prior120s mean-e,A=prior10s acceleration magnitude SD(g),dT=T-T_t-30s(degreeC). v/r coefficients dimensionless,A coefficientuS/g,dT coefficientuS/degreeC,interaction coefficient1/g.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Show every group and matched-baseline difference. Few groups/dates do not justify narrow population confidence intervals; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: One aerobic study with two protocol versions; no mental-stress or clinical diagnosis. Source device clocks are not necessarily calendar measurement dates, and manufacturer EDA calibration remains author-provided.

exposure.historical_record: Public source-aware corpus; internally reserved confirmation opened only after candidate/selection/stopping freeze. Outcomes now exposed to future users. This is computational confirmation, not independent experimental replication.

scope: One middle eligible forecast origin from every native recording/session with at least one eligible origin; all currently exposed partitions covered.
native_prefix_audit.limits: Released-product prefix invariance at tested origins; not a proof of publisher upstream processing causality or every possible mutation.
